items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Small, clear change with a short explanatory comment ('parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth so we'll add it ourselves.'). Naming and style match the file. The only nit is that a blank line before 'if scheme is None:' was removed.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The utils.py fix itself is minimal and idiomatic. However, the workspace diff also deletes unrelated files docs/dev/authors.rst and docs/dev/contributing.rst (git status shows 'deleted:'), which is collateral damage outside the task's scope.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: There is a guard ('if auth:') and no exceptions are swallowed. The empty-host case is handled sensibly because auth is joined before the netloc/path swap, so 'http://u:p@/path' gives 'u:p@' plus '/path', which matches the old urlparse behaviour.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: Signature is unchanged. auth is taken from parse_url's field and re-joined with '@'.join([auth, netloc]). URLs without credentials follow the same path as before. There is no special-casing of urllib3 or the Python version.
